description.text: Chinese language transfer student (join a class in the middle of courses) Courses start at any time, but students must have a previous foundation in Chinese language learning. Application must be made at least two weeks in advance.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Transfer Course at MinZu University of China is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 88 USD/per week ￥ 640 CNY/per week

materials.text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). Valid identity document of the applicant's guarantor For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.
